decisions.reason: Template reuse across locations does not change the existing requirement that each location has its own website.
The source describes reuse of website structure and does not change the separate Wix-account model.
Reusing a location-site template does not change master-site location discovery or routing.
The source does not change the master domain or any domain-to-website mapping.
The existing same-message MODIFY captures the shared layout but omits the explicitly permitted location-specific branding and wording variations.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: It's really one type of website that stays the same throughout all the websites—we copy and paste it and just change the branding and wording. All packages and prices stay the same.

decisions.reason: Shared site structure, branding variation, and consistent packages do not change the requirement for separate location payouts.
The package and pricing consistency stated by the source is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE event.
Template reuse does not alter the existing requirement that each location maintain its own calendar.
The source does not change the separate payment-processing placement or payment setup for each location.
Copying a common site structure across location websites does not change which legacy content, images, or booking information are reused.
Consistent templates, packages, and pricing do not change separate revenue and sales tracking by location.
The source does not change the requirement for each location to manage its bookings separately.
